messages:
violet: Heads up — after upgrading @redwood/inference-js to 2.2.0 our edge widget grew ~480KB and fails on Vercel with "createClient is not a function" at cold start.

arjun: ugh. default import anywhere? `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'` will often cause CJS interop to pull CJS bits into ESM bundles.

violet: yes one small util uses the default import. Swapping to `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js'` changed symptom but bundle still large. Analyzer shows `dist/cjs` code present.

maia: can you paste the package.json snippet from node_modules?

violet: snippet:
```
"main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
"module": "dist/esm/index.js",
"types": "dist/index.d.ts",
"sideEffects": false,
"exports": { ".": {"import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"}, "./boot": {"import":"./dist/esm/boot.js","require":"./dist/cjs/boot.js"} }
```

arjun: yep — `sideEffects: false` + a boot/runtime file = bundlers may drop the boot file. Also if the ESM entry re-exports a default from CJS via a commonjs shim, that pulls the whole CJS bundle in and prevents tree-shaking. Two problems.

maia: short-term consumer fixes we've used: 1) pin to 2.1.x, 2) explicitly import the boot file (`import '@redwood/inference-js/boot'`) early, or 3) import from explicit ESM path (`@redwood/inference-js/esm`). All are brittle for DX but work.

violet: tried the boot import — runtime fixed but TypeScript in our monorepo complained. Pinning to 2.1.x for now.

build-bot: Created ticket SDK-EDGE-2042: "js-sdk: incorrect sideEffects + cjs interop causes edge runtime error and bundle bloat" assigned to eng-devex.

arjun: Action for SDK owners: either list the boot file in sideEffects allowlist or remove the flag; publish a pure ESM entry that doesn't re-export CJS via interop shims; make runtime init explicit (export initBoot) and add integration tests for vite/esbuild/webpack + edge. Also verify published d.ts paths.

kevin: I'll add a short troubleshooting note to the upgrade guide and an example showing the recommended imports for Next/Vercel edge.

violet: thanks — will keep pinned and watch SDK-EDGE-2042. :thumbsup:
